description: Check a dashboard tile and read its query once, as you, before you put it in a dashboard: returns its output, or why it has none. A spec is {"v": 1, "tiles": [...], "layout": {"rows": [["t1", "t2"], ["t3"]]}}: at most 20 tiles, each in exactly one row of 1 to 3. A tile is {"id": "t1" (1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter or digit), "title": 1 to 80 characters, "ontology_id", "load": {"kind": "current"} (whichever load is current when it is viewed) or {"kind": "pinned", "load_id"}, "query": a typed query, the query read of helix_foundry_read_graph (helix_foundry_read_guide gives its schema): at most 200 rows or 100 groups, "visual": {"kind": "table" | "bar" | "line" | "figure"} or {} to show it as its output suits}. An answer's visual (helix_foundry_ask's) is a tile already: its question's queries[].query with the visual's kind and title.
